QUESTIONS

What people ask before they message.

What does Jwero’s business email do?

Email marketing and business email for jewellers: mailboxes on your own domain, a drag-and-drop designer with AI-written campaigns, A/B testing, open and click tracking, abandoned cart emails, all in the same inbox as WhatsApp. It is part of Jwero One: ₹18,000 a month, every module included, with the first month at ₹3,600.

What is email marketing for jewellers?

Sending the right customers festival offers, new collections, occasion wishes and cart reminders by email. Jwero sends to segments from your customer record, with AI-written copy, A/B testing, and opens and clicks tracked.

Can AI write my email campaigns?

Yes. AI writes the subject and copy from your brief; you edit in the drag-and-drop designer and approve before it sends.

Can I A/B test emails?

Yes. Test subject lines or versions, and send the winner to the rest.

Are abandoned cart emails included?

Yes. Abandoned cart and browse journeys send by email, alongside WhatsApp and other channels.

Can I see who opened and clicked?

Yes. Opens and clicks are tracked and written to each customer’s record.

Do I need to buy email hosting separately?

No. You create mailboxes on your own domain inside Jwero, charged per mailbox. See pricing.

Can I keep my existing Google Workspace or Zoho Mail?

Yes. Connect it, and its email lands in the same inbox as WhatsApp.

Will my emails land in spam?

Mail is signed with DKIM, SPF and DMARC, which inbox providers check, and bounced addresses stop being mailed.

Will the AI answer my email on its own?

It drafts. Replies wait for approval until you decide which may run alone.
